drafts.title: Broken stall? Report it from the Tesla app now
drafts.angle: One tap fixes the charger for the next guy. Quote-post a big verified account that's already moving, with his own bad-stall story.
bullets: @TeslaCharging (verified): Report an Issue in the Tesla app now has more categories for Superchargers, Megachargers and Destination Chargers.
Categories include broken chargers, blocked stalls, cleanliness and weather problems. You can add the stall number and photos, even without charging.
Reports go to Tesla's 24/7 Operations team.
The @TeslaCharging post had about 71.8K impressions, 911 likes and 88 reposts when the pack pulled it.

drafts.title: I-70 this Thanksgiving week, EV road check
drafts.angle: CDOT says busy, not crazy. Dry through Thursday, weekend snow is the wild card. Local, useful, and his Colorado followers can answer the question.
bullets: CDOT (Summit Daily, Nov 23): expect I-70 backups the Wednesday before Thanksgiving and Saturday through Monday after, but a weak snow year so far means not gangbusters.
Mostly dry on the I-70 mountain corridor Tuesday through Thursday (OpenSnow); some weekend snow possible, low confidence.
Eastbound sun-glare detours possible near Idaho Springs, sunrise to 8:30 a.m.
Traction law still applies; check COTrip.org before heading out.

drafts.title: $300 plug-in solar, now legal in 11 states
drafts.angle: You don't need a $30,000 roof job to start making your own power. Renter angle, led by the 11-state number (not California, which was Nov 20). Keep his own roof to one line since he posted his 24-panel bills post Nov 23.
bullets: Bloomberg (via Spokesman-Review, Nov 23): 11 states now allow small plug-in balcony solar without utility permission; 24+ more are considering it.
Most cap it at 1,200 watts, enough for a fridge, electronics and lights; savings of several hundred dollars a year.
Kits run about $300 to $2,000 vs about $30,000 for rooftop.
California enacted its law in September; New York's bill awaits Gov. Hochul. The article doesn't say where Colorado stands, so don't claim it.
drafts.body: $300 to $2,000 for a solar panel you plug into a wall outlet. 11 states allow it now. I've got panels on my roof, but a renter can't do that. This they can take with them. Would you put one on your balcony?
drafts.framework_body:
$300 to $2,000. That's a solar panel you plug straight into a wall outlet. 11 states now allow it without asking the utility, and 24 more are looking at it.

Most cap it at 1,200 watts. Enough for the fridge, lights and the TV during the day. Figure a few hundred bucks a year off the bill.

drafts.title: People took the AI's wrong answer about 80% of the time
drafts.angle: AI is a helper, not the boss. Check it on anything with money in it. Number opener, plain-English lesson.
bullets: Wharton study (Shaw and Nave), 1,372 participants on reasoning puzzles.
People used the AI on over half the problems and went with its answer about 80% of the time, even when it was rigged to be wrong.
Wrong AI dropped accuracy 15 points below no-AI; right AI raised it 25 points.
People felt more confident after using AI, even when it misled them.
